ratings.note: Autofill +44, separators or lower-case are occasional; error at the final commit step needs retyping without saying why; recurs each attempt.
Desktop is the minority device; empty space on confirm/done is visual only, the content stays readable.
Baskets over three tools are rare; when it happens the member learns at the desk that some tools cannot be lent; one-off.
15 of 21 days are closed and all look selectable; the failure surfaces only at Confirm with no link back to the tool page; recurs for members who do not learn the Open mark.
Only members who type details before using Change meet it; cost is retyping three fields on a phone; recurs on each round trip.
Dark mode is common; screenshot shows the badge text dim but legible (about 3.1:1) with no pill; persists in dark mode. 1.4.3 failure is handled by the a11y floor.
Native date/select controls in the filter panel work; yyyy/mm/dd mask and styling mismatch are cosmetic. Suggested s=0, but I agree it is a real (cosmetic) problem, so 1 is the lowest valid value.
Seen on every page, but lack of a visual identity does not hinder any task; cosmetic/brand concern.
Screen-reader members on find and basket; flattened heading outline slows navigation by heading; constant.
Mis-taps on Remove are occasional; recovery means rebuilding day and loan choices and possibly losing the one-of-each hold; one-off per occurrence.
Desktop basket shows sessions latest-first with a stranded card; can mislead the session choice but full date labels allow recovery; recurs each visit.
Grey band below footer at 1280x900 is purely visual. Suggested s=0, but I agree it is a real (cosmetic) problem, so 1 is the lowest valid value.
Members on phones who want search must scroll past ten cards; with only ten tools the list itself still serves the task; returning members learn it.
Date-filter users (top task 3); the filter shows the opposite of its label, so members wrongly conclude tools are unavailable; recurs every use.
Interrupted phone sessions often exceed 10 minutes; the hold expires with no disclosure, warning or extension (2.2.1); recurs each session.
8 of 10 names truncated on phones, both drills read "Cordless drill 18 V, co..."; tool page heading allows recovery; every visit.
Phone members opening loan length; screenshot shows only "One week" visible, the rest under the Reserve bar, so other lengths look absent; recurs each time.
Desktop-only empty right half; visual composition only. Suggested s=0, but I agree it is a real (cosmetic) problem, so 1 is the lowest valid value.

Every reservation meets latest-first sessions; picking the wrong Saturday sets the tool aside a week late. Below s=4 because labels give full dates and the confirm summary repeats the session, so many catch it.
Returning members re-enter a short search; with ten tools the cost is trivial.
Contrast-theme users on phones are few, but for them session days become indistinguishable while the instruction still refers to a green dot; constant.
Contradiction appears whenever the session differs from the day, including every Change; confirm shows two different collection dates at commitment; recurs each reservation.
Dark mode common; the soonest-available badge loses its pill and looks weaker; text still readable.
Every completed reservation leaves Basket (1) and the drill listed; causes doubt and possible duplicate reservation; persists until removed.
No identity/focal point; visible everywhere but no task impact.
Misaligned value columns in Details; specs still readable.
Same dark-mode badge issue: soonest-available badge loses its tint and contrast; readable with effort.

3-4 of 10 tools are on loan and the basket says "You can collect at any of these sessions"; the booking cannot be fulfilled and is discovered only at the desk (wasted trip); recurs for each such reservation.
Every basket user; no hold duration is stated and, with one of each tool, an unannounced expiry loses the hold; recurs each reservation.
Only matters when contacting the desk; mix-up is recoverable by phone.
"Oct" wraps alone on phone badges; legible, cosmetic.
Every phone search; results change above view and only the last result is visible, so the wrong drill may be opened; tool heading allows recovery.
Speech-input users are few; "10 Open" not in the name, though "10" is, so most commands still match; constant.
Screen-reader users hear only "One week, button"; the preceding heading gives context; constant.
Native filter controls and offset label; functional, cosmetic inconsistency. Suggested s=0, but I agree it is a real (cosmetic) problem, so 1 is the lowest valid value.
Most calendar days are non-session days and the choice is accepted silently, then carried into basket/confirm; recurs for first-time members.
Desktop session list backwards with uneven grid; may mislead the session choice, recoverable via labels.
Widths below 362 px are occasional; 42 px horizontal overflow on the main list is an annoyance, not a block; always at that width.
Phone members wanting search scroll two-thirds down the page; the ten-card list is a workable fallback; returning members learn it.
Every confirmation; key details (number, session, deposit) do not stand out, making them harder to retain; one look per reservation.
Zero-match searches and filters; stale results are shown as if current with no status update, so a member may act on wrong availability; recurs every no-match.
Members needing the date/category filter meet an icon-only control; the filter glyph is conventional but may be missed for top task 3.
Screen-reader members hear the tool name twice and may wonder if two were reserved; every confirmation.
Every use of Change (core task) opens the basket with nothing selected; recall plus possible error round-trip.
Same as search-below-list on phones; extra scrolling, list is a fallback, learned by returning members.
Screen-reader users navigating by landmark miss the primary action; linear reading still reaches it; constant.
Keyboard users cannot dismiss the loan list with Escape; selecting an option closes it; recurs.
Every phone reservation: day grid below the fold and heading under the bar; the inline error recovers; learned after one use.
Nav links wrap to two lines on phones; still readable and tappable.
Keyboard and screen-reader members on the session decision get reversed order versus the screen; arrow keys move opposite, risking the wrong week; recurs every visit.
Unstocked or misspelled searches show the unchanged list with no message; confusing rather than misleading for search terms; recurs.
Same truncation: both drills identical on phones; recoverable on the tool page; every visit.
Keyboard users on find and basket get focus order contrary to visual order; reversed sessions risk a wrong pick; always.
Every reservation re-asks the collection choice with nothing preselected, causing an error detour or a mismatched session; recurs every time.
End of tool page sits under the fixed bar, hiding the desk phone number / last row; scrolling cannot reveal it; recurs.
Keyboard users can open the list with Enter/Space; missing arrow-key opening is a convenience gap.
Both commit buttons show no visible change for 1.2-1.5 s on every reservation; leads to uncertainty and repeat taps; recurs.
Identical placeholder thumbnails on every card; adds no information but names carry identity.
No product-derived identity; brand concern without task impact.
Reservation number lacks emphasis; it is present and readable.
Needs an error followed by removing the last item; stale alert confuses briefly.
Keyboard users tab through 21 days to reach Reserve; slow but surmountable; every tool page.
Keyboard users cycling inside the open loan list; Enter on the current option leaves it, so not a hard trap; recurs.

Members pausing over 10 minutes (common in interrupted phone use, as the expired-state screenshot shows) get "Something went wrong. Try again." on every retry with no way out; blocks the critical journey.
No-results search on phones shows the full list without message; confusion and wasted scrolling.
Double taps are invited by the silent 1.5 s wait; two reservation numbers for one booking confuse what to quote at the desk; recurs on each double tap.
Unstocked/misspelled searches leave all ten tools and an empty status; member may think search failed; recoverable.
Members typing only digits get a message identical to the empty state; the example lets them recover after a retry.
Sighted keyboard users on phones: focus on most session days is fully hidden under the Reserve bar (2.4.11), forcing blind presses; every visit.
Every Reserve; toast gone after 1.35 s. One below s=3 because the header Basket count also updates; the larger harm is captured in the next-step finding.
Details split into two misaligned lists; specs still readable.
Every use of Change returns to an unselected session list; extra recall and a possible error.
Same placeholder thumbnail on all cards; cosmetic, names identify tools.
Every first reservation (primary group): "Reserve this tool" only adds to the basket and the toast vanishes, so members may leave with no reservation and find nothing set aside on Saturday.
Open loan list stays open after outside click or blur; members must press the button or choose an option; recurs.
Toast briefly overlaps calendar cells for about 1.35 s; transient.
Same truncation on phones; the distinguishing words are hidden; tool heading allows recovery.
Twice per reservation no acknowledgement for about 1 s; repeat taps on the commit button; recurs.
Every confirmation shows Basket (1); doubt whether the reservation went through and risk of re-reserving; persists.
